channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Bolsa Família reajustado começa a ser pago nesta 2ª feira
item.description: The federal government adjusted the Bolsa Família benefit by 15.04%, raising the minimum from R$ 600 to R$ 691 and the average benefit from R$ 675 to R$ 777. The budget cost will be R$ 5.8 billion in 2026 and R$ 22 billion in 2027, with adjustments included in the budget proposal. The measure was announced 17 days before the first round of elections, but the government denies electoral intent.

item.title: Debate virou uma luta livre, e eleitorado entrou com a cara
item.description: The debate between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro devolved into a schoolyard fight, marked by verbal aggressions and aggressive posture. The electorate was impacted by the intensity of the confrontation, which exceeded expectations. Polarization intensified with exchanges of insults and personal attacks.

item.title: PM é acionada durante debate e descarta suspeita de bomba em carro na Band
item.description: The PM was called during a debate between Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) to investigate a bomb threat in a car parked at Band's lot. After inspection, police ruled out any risk. The incident did not disrupt the debate.

item.title: Presos podem votar? Entenda regra citada no debate entre Flávio e Lula
item.description: The right to vote for imprisoned individuals was discussed in the debate between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, highlighting disagreements on electoral rules. The Brazilian Constitution allows voting for defendants in process but not for those convicted with imprisonment sentences.

item.title: Decepcionante, triste, vergonhoso, infeliz: como eleitores analisaram o debate entre Flávio e Lula
item.description: Voters in a qualitative research group deemed the debate between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro disappointing, sad, and shameful, highlighting a lack of proposals and low discussion quality. Most participants, regardless of their vote, criticized the absence of relevant issues and the confrontational tone that discouraged voters. Lula was seen as repetitive and demagogic, while Flávio was judged empty and overly aggressive.

item.title: Quem ganhou e quem perdeu no primeiro debate entre Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The first debate between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro on Band was marked by direct attacks and a lack of proposals, leaving independent voters dissatisfied. Analysts believe the confrontation will not significantly influence voting decisions and may even encourage abstention or blank and null votes.

item.title: Arrogância e nervosismo em um ‘circo dos horrores’: colunistas avaliam debate entre Flávio e Lula
item.description: The first debate between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro was marked by accusations and tense audience behavior, with no major policy proposals. Columnists highlighted Flávio's arrogant posture, describing the event as a 'circus of horrors', with no clear winner.

item.title: Primeiro debate entre Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro tem troca de acusações e poucas propostas
item.description: The first debate between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro was marked by mutual attacks and few proposals, with emphasis on corruption accusations. Both addressed public security and debt, but prioritized criticism over concrete solutions.

item.title: Padilha rebate Flávio sobre pandemia e hospitais do Rio
item.description: Minister of Health Alexandre Padilha criticized Flávio Bolsonaro's management in the health sector, warning of risks similar to those at Rio's federal hospitals. During the Band debate, Flávio acknowledged failures during the pandemic but denied corruption charges and illegal fees. Padilha highlighted suspicions of over R$100 million in embezzlement and unlicensed contracts.

item.title: Nikolas critica modelo de debate da “Band”: “Não é eficaz”
item.description: Deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) criticized the open format of the Band's presidential debate, deeming it 'not effective'. He noted that Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) appeared 'calm' and discussed proposals, whereas President Lula (PT) seemed 'nervous' but more aggressive. The debate, moderated by Adriana Araújo and Eduardo Oinegue, marked the first direct confrontation between the two candidates in the runoff.

item.title: Nikolas zoa Haddad e Tebet na “Band”: “Estão desempregados”
item.description: Federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) mocked Fernando Haddad and Simone Tebet after the Band presidential debate, calling them unemployed for losing the 2026 elections. Haddad and Tebet did not respond to the provocations. The debate marked the first direct confrontation between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro in the runoff.

item.title: Lula chama Dani Marques de “mulher da economia”, e direita vê machismo
item.description: During the Band debate, Lula referred to Daniella Marques as 'the economy woman,' which Flávio Bolsonaro and allies viewed as a sexist remark. Daniella responded that the comment was misogynistic and emphasized her professional trajectory, rejecting being reduced in her role in the campaign.

item.title: Pesquisa do PT avalia que debate não deve mudar votos de indecisos
item.description: A qualitative survey commissioned by the PT shows that the Band debate between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro did not change the voting intentions of undecided voters, despite Lula being rated better. Most participants prefer debates focused on proposals rather than attacks, highlighting issues such as cost of living, SUS, and prices.

item.title: Las claves del primer debate en Brasil: un Lula tecnócrata ante un Bolsonaro provocador
item.description: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro debated in São Paulo in a forum organized by Band and Estadão. Bolsonaro attacked from the start, while Lula was more technical and focused on economy and international alliances.

item.title: Ato pró-Flávio tem míssil inflável pedindo ataque de Trump
item.description: At a Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) rally in São Paulo, protesters carried an inflatable missile labeled 'Trump nuke Brazil', calling for a nuclear strike by U.S. President Donald Trump against Brazil. The incident sparked social media reactions and criticism from President Lula (PT), who deemed the act treasonous and questioned Eduardo Bolsonaro's ties to the U.S.

item.title: Gate descarta bomba em carro da comitiva de Flávio Bolsonaro no debate
item.description: The São Paulo Military Police's Special Tactical Actions Group (GATE) dismissed the bomb hypothesis in a vehicle from Flávio Bolsonaro's entourage during a debate on the evening of the 18th. The alert, reported by Senate police, involved detection dogs identifying chemical components, but ammonia, commonly found in airbags, was later confirmed as the substance. Both candidates, Flávio and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, left the venue without incident.

item.title: Quando será o debate presidencial da Globo? Veja a data e o horário
item.description: The TV Globo presidential debate between Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) will take place on October 23rd, immediately after the Jornal Nacional, broadcast live and moderated by César Tralli. The event will be simultaneously streamed on TV Globo, GloboNews, and digital platforms such as g1 and Globoplay.

item.title: O ‘troco’ de Lula em Flávio sobre o voto de Jair Bolsonaro
item.description: In a presidential debate, Lula taunted Flávio Bolsonaro by suggesting he convince his father, Jair Bolsonaro jailed for far-right coup plotting, to vote for him. The face-off highlighted corruption allegations and scandals involving both candidates. Polls show a technical tie ahead of the runoff.

item.title: Apoiadores de Flávio fazem campanha “carioca não é malandro”
item.description: Supporters of Flávio Bolsonaro launched the campaign 'carioca is not a malandro' after Lula called him 'malandro carioca' in the Band debate. The senator stated Lula's remark offended residents of Rio de Janeiro. The debate was the first direct confrontation between the candidates in the runoff.

item.title: Ato pró-Flávio em SP x ato pró-Lula no Rio: qual teve o maior público
item.description: The pro-Flávio Bolsonaro rally in São Paulo drew 71,900 attendees, according to the USP monitor, surpassing the pro-Lula rally in Rio, which gathered 56,400 people. Both events took place before the first debate between the candidates on Sunday night.

item.title: Bolsonaro se lanza contra Lula en un primer debate muy bronco
item.description: Flavio Bolsonaro and Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva faced off in a televised debate at TV Bando's studios in Sao Paulo on Sunday night, breaking tradition by engaging directly after avoiding confrontation in the first round. Bolsonaro launched aggressive attacks against his rival, while Lula took a more restrained approach, offering explanations as a governing leader and seeking to mobilize the 33 million abstainers.

item.title: Pavanato chama Haddad de “demitido” e leva tapinha no rosto
item.description: Following the Band debate between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, congressman Lucas Pavanato (PL-SP) called former Finance Minister Fernando Haddad (PT-SP) 'Taxad' and 'demitted', leading to a verbal and physical altercation, including slaps to the face. Haddad retorted that Pavanato had lost the São Paulo gubernatorial race and called him 'tonto'.

item.title: As gafes do presidente Lula durante o debate na Band
item.description: During the Band TV debate, President Lula made gaffes by suggesting Brazil 'ended' in a fourth term and calling Flávio Bolsonaro a 'malandro carioca'. The debate featured mutual accusations of corruption involving the candidates and their allies. Polls show a technical tie between Lula and Flávio ahead of the runoff.

item.title: Flávio abusa de provocações, Lula cai em armadilhas e debate deixa eleitor sem respostas
item.description: The 2026 presidential debate was marked by insults and a lack of concrete proposals, leaving voters without clear decision-making elements. Flávio Bolsonaro started with a moderate tone but resorted to irony and attacks, while Lula fell into provocations and seemed lost. Neither candidate significantly gained or lost voters.

item.title: Com tática de Trump, Flávio desestabiliza Lula em debate raso e com risco de desanimar o eleitor
item.description: In the first presidential debate between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, the discourse was marked by low content and provocations, with Flávio dominating the time and using Trump-like tactics, while Lula showed irritability, calling the opponent a 'clown'. The shallow and polarized debate may increase voter abstention.

item.title: ELEIÇÕES 2026: ANÁLISE DO DEBATE PRESIDENCIAL ENTRE LULA E FLÁVIO BOLSONARO - 18/10/2026
item.description: The 2026 presidential debate between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro was tense, marked by mutual criticism and conflicting positions on economy and security. Key issues such as corruption and reforms were debated without clear consensus.

item.title: ÍNTEGRA: 1º debate entre Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro nas eleições 2026
item.description: The first debate between Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Flávio Bolsonaro in the 2026 elections focused on political and electoral issues, highlighting their contest for the presidency.

item.title: Circulação de Flávio Bolsonaro atrás de Lula interrompe debate e gera confusão na plateia
item.description: During a debate on TV Band, Flávio Bolsonaro interrupted Lula's closing remarks by approaching the candidate, causing chaos in the audience. The moderator asked him to step back while supporters and advisors argued nearby. The incident mirrors Trump's tactics during the 2016 election cycle.

item.title: Polícia isola área por suspeita de bomba em carro de Flávio após debate na Band
item.description: Following the first debate between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, police isolated a car belonging to the PL candidate over a suspected bomb. The Gate tactical unit determined it was a false alarm, though dogs detected potential bomb-making chemicals. Flávio departed the scene without speaking to press.

item.title: Embate de forma e esperteza, sem conteúdo
item.description: The debate between Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula was marked by clashes of style and attack strategies, lacking depth in policy proposals. Flávio dominated the stage but avoided addressing issues like health, education, and the economy, while Lula missed the opportunity to highlight positive indicators from the previous administration.

item.title: Gate é acionado para checar carro de Flávio Bolsonaro após suspeita de bomba durante debate na Band
item.description: The Special Tactics Action Group (GATE) inspected Flávio Bolsonaro's car after a bomb threat during a debate on Band; no explosive device was found. The candidate left accompanied by São Paulo governor Tarcísio de Freitas. During the debate, Flávio and Lula exchanged accusations regarding corruption and public security.

item.title: Bastidores: debate Band/Estadão tem bate-boca entre aliados, provocações e pedidos de expulsão
item.description: The first presidential debate between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, broadcast by Band/Estadão, was marked by tensions, provocations, and calls for expulsion behind the scenes. The rivalry between the candidates extended to the audience, with allies from both sides exchanging accusations and polemical statements, requiring organizational intervention to control conflicts.

item.title: A audiência da Band durante o primeiro debate entre Flávio e Lula
item.description: Band achieved 15.21 points in Ibope during the first debate between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, with 5 million simultaneous YouTube viewers. The debate, marked by corruption accusations, took place a week before the runoff, as polls show a technical tie between the candidates.

item.title: Flávio mimetiza Marçal, provoca Lula e foge de todas as perguntas
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro mimics Pablo Marçal, provokes Lula and avoids answering questions about ties with Vorcaro, votes against social policies and defense of figures linked to police violence cases. During the debate, he refuses to clarify past actions and dodges Lula's challenge on opening sigils.

item.title: Lula desafia Flávio a abrir conta bancária 'para saber quem é ladrão'
item.description: In a presidential debate on Band, Lula challenged Flávio Bolsonaro to open family bank accounts and phone records to investigate alleged corruption acts. The challenge aimed to pressure the senator to disclose potential irregularities.

item.title: Em debate, Lula defende legado econômico, enquanto Flávio destaca custo de vida e dívidas
item.description: In the first runoff debate, Lula emphasized his economic legacy, while Flávio criticized rising prices and debt. Both addressed topics like economy and public policies.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro evita dizer se adotará modelo Milei no Brasil
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro avoided committing to adopting Milei-like policies during a presidential debate. Lula questioned possible alliance and Argentine economic model. PL candidate kept evasive stance.

item.title: Lula questiona sobre SUS; Flávio faz mea culpa sobre saúde no governo Jair Bolsonaro
item.description: In a Band/Estado debate, President Lula criticized Jair Bolsonaro's handling of the pandemic and questioned opponents' commitment to SUS. Flávio Bolsonaro responded with a mea-culpa regarding health policies during the previous administration, acknowledging failures in managing the health crisis.

item.title: Flávio cita custo de vida; Lula reage: 'Mais caro era no governo Bolsonaro'
item.description: In a Band debate, Lula rebutted Flávio Bolsonaro's criticism regarding inflation, claiming the cost of living was higher under Bolsonaro's government. Flávio emphasized the impact of inflation under the PT administration.

item.title: Flávio diz que R$ 134 mi de Vorcaro está no filme sobre o pai; Lula diz que prendeu banqueiro
item.description: In a Band/Estadão presidential debate, Lula and Flávio clashed: Lula labeled Flávio as irresponsible, claiming that the Bolsonaro government turned the former Banco Master banker into a fugitive and that his government arrested him. Flávio countered, alleging that R$134 million from Vorcaro is tied to a film project about his father, suggesting misuse of funds.

item.title: Lula diz que Flávio é 'malandro carioca'; Flávio diz se solidarizar com cariocas ofendidos
item.description: In a recent debate, President Lula called Flávio Bolsonaro a 'chronic liar' and 'scoundrel from Rio.' Flávio reacted sarcastically, claiming solidarity with Rio residents offended by the remarks. The exchange sparked backlash on social media.

item.title: Lula propõe a Flávio abrir sigilos bancário e telefônico de suas famílias
item.description: In a debate on Band, Lula challenged Flávio Bolsonaro to open banking and phone records of both candidates' families before the runoff, suggesting documents be reviewed by the Supreme Court and Electoral Court. The proposal came amid discussions on corruption and the Bolsonaro family's ties to the US.

item.title: Lula cobra Flávio por empregar familiares de acusado no caso Marielle
item.description: Lula questioned Flávio Bolsonaro over hiring relatives of Adriano da Nóbrega, linked to the Marielle Franco crime office. The race remains tied at 50%, per the latest poll.

item.title: Flávio conhece ônibus e trabalho por literatura, diz Lula
item.description: Lula claims Flávio Bolsonaro knows buses and workers only through literature, during Band debate. The PL candidate advocates for reducing work hours with public safety and increasing purchasing power.

item.title: Roberta Luchsinger reage e posta vídeo após ser chamada de ‘mentirosa’ por Lula em debate na Band
item.description: Roberta Luchsinger responded to Lula's accusations, denying being called a liar and stating she has evidence regarding ties between the government and her circle, including the president's son. She confirmed cooperating with authorities and expressed concerns over her safety and that of her daughters. The federal government denied any contact with her or with Fábio Lula.

item.title: Lula diz que eventual indulto a Bolsonaro pode beneficiar Vorcaro
item.description: In a presidential debate, Lula stated that a pardon for Jair Bolsonaro could benefit other convicts, such as Daniel Vorcaro, and defended temporary prison leaves for well-behaved inmates, excluding serious crimes. Flávio Bolsonaro criticized the stance, accusing the PT leader of favoring criminals over victims.

item.title: Flávio cobra Lula sobre “saidinhas”; petista defende benefício
item.description: In a presidential debate, Flávio Bolsonaro pressured Lula on 'saidinhas' and cited crimes committed by beneficiary inmates, while Lula defended the right of well-behaved prisoners, reaffirming the focus on resocialization.

item.title: Lula propõe abrir sigilos bancário e telefônico e desafia Flávio
item.description: In a Band debate, President Lula proposed opening the banking and phone records of Flávio Bolsonaro and his relatives to expose potential corruption. The proposal came amid mutual accusations between the politicians regarding irregularities involving family members and allies.

item.title: Lula diz que Eduardo Bolsonaro instiga "golpe contra o Brasil” nos EUA
item.description: Lula accused Eduardo Bolsonaro of instigating a coup against Brazil in the US, during a debate on Band TV. He claimed the Bolsonaro family is subordinated to American interests. Flávio Bolsonaro denied the accusations, calling them lies.

item.title: Debate: Flávio e Lula trocam ataques sobre CV, PCC e Escudo das Américas
item.description: In a debate on TV Band, Lula and Flávio traded accusations regarding public security, criticizing Brazil's relationship with the U.S. and the fight against organized crime. Lula questioned Flávio's activities in the United States and suggested he defends North American interests, while Flávio advocated for joining the Shield of the Americas and criticized Lula for preventing the PCC and CV from being classified as terrorist groups. The debate also touched on critical minerals, rare earths, and the use of the Armed Forces to reinforce borders.
